rationale: All 11 prior blocking findings resolved: _sum_or_none uses is-not-None guard (CR-001); LiteLLM classifier cost zeroed when Switchyard metadata present (CR-002); seen_ids dedup prevents duplicate header maps per generation (CR-003); classifier_total_tokens forwarded through RoutingInfo, extractor, proxy, and monitoring service (CR-004); all public method signatures use dict[str, Any] (CR-005); value_count aggregation replaces hits.total for request_count (CR-006); date_histogram + terms sub-agg produces ordered timeline (CR-007); is-not-None guard on session_id filter (CR-008); cached_tokens sum added to classifier-overhead aggregation and parser (CR-009); two new conversation-service routing tests cover both branches (CR-010); reduce lambda corrected to b.merged_over(a) so last run wins (CR-011).

business_review.item: RoutingInfo carries 7 new fields; is_empty and merged_over handle them
business_review.notes: All 7 fields added; is_empty covers them; merged_over semantically correct. calculate() reduce lambda inverted: first-non-None wins, not last; spec and old code required last-non-None. See CR-011.

business_review.item: SwitchyardRoutingExtractor and LiteLLMRouterExtractor populate all new RoutingInfo fields
business_review.notes: Both extractors updated with most new fields. x-litellm-classifier-total-tokens (LiteLLMRouterMeta.classifier_total_tokens) is never forwarded to RoutingInfo in either extractor or proxy direct construction. See CR-004.

business_review.item: routing_call_usage ES event emitted for each conversation/agent request where routing was active
business_review.notes: conversation_service.py emits routing metric when routing is non-empty; conversation_id, assistant_id, project, request_id all populated.

business_review.item: routing_call_usage ES event emitted for each proxy-endpoint request where routing was active
business_review.notes: proxy_router.py emits routing metric as background task when not empty; gated by LLM_PROXY_TRACK_USAGE; endpoint and request_id forwarded.

business_review.item: conversation_assistant_usage documents unchanged — no routing fields added to that event type
business_review.notes: send_conversation_metric call unmodified; routing event is a separate downstream call.

business_review.item: Requests from either path with no routing metadata produce no routing_call_usage event
business_review.notes: is_empty() guard present in RoutingMonitoringService and proxy path; confirmed by test.

business_review.item: MetricName.ROUTING_CALL_USAGE = 'routing_call_usage' added to MetricName enum
business_review.notes: metric_names.py diff adds ROUTING_CALL_USAGE = 'routing_call_usage' in the Routing metrics section.

business_review.item: RoutingMonitoringService(BaseMonitoringService) with send_routing_metric; no-op when routing.is_empty()
business_review.notes: New file; inherits BaseMonitoringService; is_empty guard present; all routing dimensions and correlation fields emitted via send_count_metric.

business_review.item: RequestSummary.calculate() routing rollup replaced with merged_over reduce across all per-run RoutingInfo values
business_review.notes: Manual logic replaced with functools.reduce. Lambda a.merged_over(b) makes earlier runs win for scalars; spec requires last-non-None wins. Old code used reversed() for this reason. See CR-011.

business_review.item: RoutingHandler wired into AnalyticsService as lazy _routing_handler property; uses MetricsElasticRepository and AnalyticsQueryPipeline
business_review.notes: analytics_service.py adds lazy property; RoutingHandler(self._user, self._repository) constructed; AnalyticsQueryPipeline used.

business_review.item: get_routing_summary: session count, request count, total classifier overhead cost
business_review.notes: Cardinality for session_count, sum for classifier cost present. request_count uses hits.total.value which is always 0 with track_total_hits:False — see CR-006 for the runtime defect.

business_review.item: get_model_switches: ordered timeline for a single session by conversation_id (terms + date-histogram)
business_review.notes: Terms agg on routed_model present and session_id filter applied. Date-histogram for ordered timeline absent; endpoint returns count-by-model distribution, not chronological sequence. See CR-007.

business_review.item: get_tier_distribution: count per tier value (terms aggregation)
business_review.notes: routing_handler.py uses _build_terms_agg on TIER_KEYWORD; REST endpoint GET /analytics/routing/tier-distribution present.

business_review.item: get_decision_source_distribution: count per decision_source value (terms aggregation)
business_review.notes: Uses _build_terms_agg on DECISION_SOURCE_KEYWORD; REST endpoint GET /analytics/routing/decision-source-distribution present.

business_review.item: get_classifier_overhead: classifier cost and tokens broken out from primary cost; does not double-count primary model cost
business_review.notes: Sums classifier_cost_usd, classifier_input_tokens, classifier_output_tokens only; routing events separate from conversation events. classifier_cached_tokens omitted from agg — see CR-009 for the gap.

business_review.item: REST endpoints GET /routing/summary, /sessions, /sessions/{session_id}/switches, /tier-distribution, /decision-source-distribution, /classifier-overhead all present
business_review.notes: All 6 routes added to analytics.py with standard period/scope/pagination params.

business_review.item: All new endpoints return empty/zero results on deployments where LLM_PROXY_ENABLED=False
business_review.notes: Code handles 0-hit ES responses gracefully. Runtime verification needed to confirm zero-result behaviour across all endpoints.

business_review.item: Slice 3 — Savings formula: counterfactual cost minus actual routed cost including classifier overhead
business_review.notes: Hard-blocked on EPMCDME-13429; not implemented.

business_review.item: Slice 3 — Aggregate savings do not exceed aggregate counterfactual baseline
business_review.notes: Hard-blocked on EPMCDME-13429; not implemented.

business_review.item: Slice 3 — GET /analytics/routing/savings endpoint returns reconciled figure
business_review.notes: Hard-blocked on EPMCDME-13429; not implemented.

standards_review.notes: All 6 subjects follow the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format exactly (all under ticket EPMCDME-14888).

Violation: all 5 public methods in routing_handler.py and 5 new methods in analytics_service.py use bare dict instead of required dict[str, Any]. License headers and from __future__ annotations present on all new files.
All 6 new REST endpoints use Depends(authenticate). No hardcoded credentials. session_id passed to structured ES term query with no string interpolation.

finding_status.notes: _sum_or_none now uses (a if a is not None else 0) + (b if b is not None else 0); explicit 0/0.0 treated as present.
_classifier_from_litellm = routing_meta is None; LiteLLM classifier cost/tokens set to None when Switchyard metadata is present, preventing additive double-count in merged_over.
_iter_header_maps maintains seen_ids: set[int] per generation; skips any header map whose id() is already in the set, preventing duplicate yields.

classifier_total_tokens field added to RoutingInfo (line 134), included in is_empty() and merged_over(); forwarded from LiteLLMRouterMeta in LiteLLMRouterExtractor (line 70) and proxy_router (line 1166); emitted in routing_monitoring_service (line 69).
All 5 public RoutingHandler methods and private helpers annotate dict[str, Any] throughout; from typing import Any present at line 21.
_build_routing_summary_agg uses value_count on attributes.request_id.keyword; _parse_routing_summary reads aggs.get('request_count', {}).get('value'), not hits.total.value.

_build_model_switches_agg uses date_histogram (calendar_interval:day, order:_key asc) as paginated_results with terms on routed_model.keyword as sub-agg; _parse_model_switches returns timestamp + routed_model + request_count rows.
Guard changed to 'if session_id is not None:' at line 134; empty-string now triggers the term filter.
_build_classifier_overhead_agg includes total_cached_tokens sum on attributes.classifier_cached_tokens; _parse_classifier_overhead surfaces it as a Classifier Cached Tokens metric row.

test_upsert_chat_history_emits_routing_metric_when_routing_present (line 1153) and test_upsert_chat_history_skips_routing_metric_when_routing_empty (line 1203) added; former asserts send_routing_metric called with correct kwargs including routing and user.
reduce lambda corrected to 'lambda a, b: b.merged_over(a)' at line 60; b (later run) wins for scalar fields over a (accumulator); last-non-None semantics restored per spec.
